item.text: The benchmark confirms superlinear behavior: on this machine 16,000 statements take ~0.45 s and 32,000 take ~1.1 s. The execution loop prepares each statement through SQLite while passing the entire remaining script, so I’m changing preparation to cap the input window and grow it only when SQLite reports an incomplete statement. This keeps normal statements from repeatedly scanning megabytes while preserving SQLite’s parser and statement boundaries.
